MARTA KOWAL-BRANDT
QA Automation Engineer | DevOps / Platform Engineering Transition
Wroclaw, Poland | marta.kowalbrandt@example.com | +48 555 303 303 | gitlab.com/mkb-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
QA automation engineer with 7 years of experience, including two years focused largely on CI/CD pipelines, test environments and build tooling. Owns GitLab CI pipelines and namespace-level ephemeral Kubernetes test environments for three product teams. Improved average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and reduced flaky tests from 7% to below 1%. Building further infrastructure experience through a personal k3s and GitOps homelab, with Terraform used to provision a small Hetzner VPS. Seeking a DevOps or platform engineering role.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
CI/CD and containers: GitLab CI, Jenkins, Docker, Docker Compose, Helm
Infrastructure and cloud: Kubernetes (namespace-level access at work; k3s personal homelab), Terraform (personal project), Ansible (basic), AWS (learning: EC2 and S3 basics)
Monitoring and data: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, PostgreSQL, SQL
Programming and scripting: Python, Bash, Java (test code)
Testing: pytest, Playwright, Selenium, Postman
Systems and tools: Linux, Git, Argo CD, Traefik, cert-manager

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
QA Automation Engineer (Test Infrastructure) | Odrava Health Software, Wroclaw | 2021–Present
- Own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams of approximately 25 developers, covering build, unit, integration and end-to-end test stages, and artifact publishing.
- Improved average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes by parallelising test jobs, caching dependencies and separating end-to-end tests into a dedicated stage; monthly CI runner costs fell by about 30%.
- Built merge-request test environments using Docker Compose and later Helm charts deployed to a shared Kubernetes cluster; environments include the application, PostgreSQL and seeded data.
- Maintain a pytest and Playwright end-to-end suite of approximately 900 tests; reduced the flaky test rate from 7% to below 1%.
- Wrote Bash and Python tooling to seed PostgreSQL test data, and created Grafana dashboards for flaky-test metrics using CI results and PostgreSQL.
- Wrote an internal guide to the CI system used in onboarding and mentored two QA interns in 2023.

QA Engineer | Brightmill Software House, Wroclaw | 2019–2021
- Tested web and mobile applications through manual and automated testing for client projects.
- Introduced a Selenium and Java automated regression suite for the largest client project and configured Jenkins jobs for nightly runs.

Customer Support Specialist (2nd line) | Brightmill Software House | 2018–2019
- Investigated customer issues using logs and databases, and reproduced bugs for developers.

SELECTED INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS
Homelab k3s Cluster with GitOps | Personal | 2024–2025
- Set up a three-node Raspberry Pi 5 k3s cluster, with applications deployed from a Git repository using Argo CD.
- Added Prometheus, Grafana and Loki for monitoring, Traefik ingress, and cert-manager for TLS.
- Provisioned infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS using Terraform; used Ansible at a basic level.

Merge-Request Ephemeral Environments | Odrava Health | 2023–2024
- Implemented short-lived environments for merge requests, deployed through GitLab CI and Helm to the shared Kubernetes cluster.
- Configured automatic teardown after merge or 48 hours of inactivity; QA and product teams use the environments to review features, and end-to-end tests run against them.

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS
BEng Computer Engineering | Silesian Lowlands University of Technology | 2018
ISTQB Foundation Level | 2019
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA): studying; exam booked for January 2027

LANGUAGES
Polish (native), English (C1), German (A2)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Corvale Mobility Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor – Fleet Connectivity role. Over seven years in QA automation, I have increasingly focused on the infrastructure that helps product teams build, test and review software reliably. At Odrava Health Software, I own GitLab CI pipelines for three product teams and built merge-request environments on a shared Kubernetes cluster.

That work has involved making delivery systems faster and more useful to the teams relying on them. By parallelising jobs, caching dependencies and restructuring the test stages, I reduced average pipeline time from 38 to 14 minutes and monthly CI runner costs by about 30%. I also implemented short-lived Helm-deployed environments with automatic cleanup, and built test-result dashboards that helped reduce flaky tests from 7% to below 1%. I have documented the CI system for onboarding and mentored two QA interns, experience that has strengthened how I explain technical processes and support colleagues.

Alongside my work, I built a personal k3s homelab using Argo CD, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Traefik and cert-manager, and used Terraform to provision infrastructure for a small Hetzner VPS. My production infrastructure work is focused on CI/CD and namespace-level Kubernetes deployments rather than operating a cloud platform; my Terraform and AWS experience to date is personal and learning-based. I am currently studying for the CKA, with the exam booked for January 2027.

Corvale’s work to connect a new train fleet with cloud services is a compelling infrastructure challenge: reliability, observability and maintainable delivery processes matter when systems link vehicles and backend services. I would bring hands-on experience improving delivery infrastructure, working with developers and product teams, and making systems easier to test and understand. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how that experience could contribute to the Fleet Connectivity team.

Kind regards,
Marta Kowal-Brandt
